business_summary: Harbin Xinguang Optic-Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of optoelectronic products in China. The company offers automatic monitoring station for fire hazards, PTZ camera, gun bolt, spherical camera, tracked intelligent inspection robot, overhead rail robot, handheld devices, telescope, human body temperature detection camera, portable inertial goniometer, optical axis calibrator, portable imaging parameter measurement system, automated testing system for optical homing search and tracking performance, on-site optical detection system, emissivity measurement system, launcher optical axis calibration equipment, large-size measurement system for spring shaft system, laser echo detection system, customized spectrometers, complex optical scene simulation software, optical aiming system testing equipment, optical axis offset adjustment and testing equipment, composite material paving production line testing equipment, photoelectric search dynamic performance testing system, photoelectric load dynamic testing system, as well as composite imaging component debugging/testing system. It serves the power grid, forest fire prevention, oil and petrochemical, border defense, drone inspection, heating network, and agriculture sectors. Harbin Xinguang Optic-Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Harbin, China.
